title: Song - In the Bleak Midwinter (simplified)
subtitle: Arrangement: the tune with left-hand block chords
trains: In the Bleak Midwinter in F major, with its dotted rhythms, over one held block chord a bar in the left (F, B♭, C).

provenance.author: claude-opus-5.5
provenance.basedOn: mutopia-1233-cranham: Cranham (hymntune, G. Holst: In the Bleak Midwinter), SATB, F major; the tune is in the Soprano (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1233)
provenance.note: Melody from www.cyberhymnal.org (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1233), public domain; left-hand chords our own (CC0)

departures: Left-hand block chords are our own (CC0).
Simplified: one block chord a bar, held, with the three primary chords only (F, B♭, C), instead of the full version's moving left hand.
Slower: 60 instead of 72 quarter notes a minute.
